I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest. I don't have a scheduling tool in this workspace, so nothing will arrive automatically tomorrow morning.

I can still do it on demand. Say "digest" whenever you want it and I'll pull what's new in #coastal-team and DM it to you. If the channel has finance figures such as rates, prices or contract values, I'll leave those out or check with you first, since they need to go only to the account owner, Anselm or June.

If you need an automatic daily version, someone with scheduling access will have to set it up.
